## Clockwork Assassin Drone (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
N Tiny construct (clockwork)  
**Init** +8; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +5  


**Defense**


**AC** 22, touch 18, flat-footed 16 (+4 Dex, +2 Dodge, +4 natural, +2 size)  
**hp** 40 (4d10)  
**Fort** +1, **Ref** +7, **Will** +4  
**DR** 5/adamantine; **Immune** construct traits; Resist cold 10, fire 10  
**Weaknesses** vulnerable to electricity  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., fly 50 ft. (perfect)  
**Melee** sting +10 (1d3+4 plus 1d6 electricity plus poison)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 14, **Dex** 18, Con—, **Int** 15, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 16  
**Feats** Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Survival), Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Fly +22, Perception +7, Stealth +17, Survival +12  
**Languages** Common  
**SQ** hunter-killer, item installation, swift reactions, winding  


**Special Abilities**


**Hunter-Killer (Ex)** Clockwork assassin drones gain a +2 bonus on Stealth and Survival checks. They also can move at full speed without taking a penalty on such checks while tracking.  

**Poison (Ex)** Sting—injury; *save*: Fort DC 14; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect*: 1d2 Constitution damage; *cure*: 2 consecutive saves.  

**Record Vision (Ex)** This is identical to the record audio ability of a clockwork spy except that it records both vision and sound.  


**About**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** none
